integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for arXiv:1108.5327 lists version 1 as submitted on 2011-08-26 and gives primary MSC 14M10.
integrity.source_formula_role: The source supplies the complete-intersection cohomology/Chern-class premises; the balancing classification is derived separately.

scientific_limitations: Codimension and the sum of the defining degrees are fixed; codimension-varying comparisons are not covered.
Every defining degree is at least two.
An unindexed older source may contain the same balancing consequence of the classical Chern-number formula.
title: A unique balancing reversal for Euler characteristics of complete-intersection surfaces
